source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: if, when below the earth, it hold no such configuration, it is entirely deprived of efficacy

prerequisites: absence of the specified Ascendant configuration
normalized_rule: When a planet is below the earth without the specified configuration with the Ascendant, classify its influence as entirely deprived of efficacy.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific traditional influence classification, not a modern physics or psychological claim.
review_notes: Keep this below-horizon branch separate from the configured-with-Ascendant branch and from the mid-heaven/horizon strength rules.
transmission_notes: The condition is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text; no later house-rulership or accidental-dignity system is imported.
